#: Wording of the checks in test_plugins_txt.py. Keys are short Latin labels and never change - translate the right-hand sides only. Placeholders like %(mod)s are filled in by the check: keep them spelled exactly. A key starting with # is a note for translators and is ignored.
plugins.asteriskChanged: the asterisk in the file changed
plugins.fileByteIdentical: the file is byte for byte as it started
plugins.fileStillNew: the file still holds the new state
plugins.lineEndingsKept: the line endings were not substituted
plugins.restoring: putting it back as it was
plugins.subject: the plugin under test
plugins.title: plugin states reach plugins.txt
